copy.title.title:
Checking connection contracts
against the group standard
copy.title.lead: Gaius is a legal AI your team can start using right away: contract review, drafting and research in one tool, hosted in the EEA.
copy.starting-point.lead: You run the legal team of an energy group: 8 companies, 12 lawyers at headquarters. Each company keeps its own connection agreements and annexes, and manual checks against the group standard take the team’s time.
copy.starting-point.areas:
Contract compliance | Connection agreements and annexes are checked by hand against the group standard.
Scattered contracts | Each of the 8 companies keeps its own contracts, with no single view across the group.
Private chatbot use | Some lawyers use ChatGPT privately, which raises confidentiality concerns.
copy.use-areas.solutions:
Contract compliance | Clause-by-clause review against your group standard, with a list of contracts to change.
Scattered contracts | A contract register: Gaius pulls contracts out of scattered files into one searchable place.
Private chatbot use | One official AI tool for the whole team, with control over where documents go.
copy.team-support.lead: We start with a 14-day trial on real matters, then build skills with the team in three workshops on your own documents.
copy.team-support.concerns: Documents in public chatbots | Gaius is hosted in the EEA, documents are never used to train models, and files on My drive are encrypted with keys held by users.
copy.tool-comparison.lead: Some of your lawyers already use ChatGPT privately; here is how it compares with a tool built for legal work.
copy.tool-comparison.rows:
Data control | Free accounts outside your organisation’s control | One official tool, files encrypted, keys with users
Citations | Can make up rulings and statute numbers | Cites the statute or ruling behind every answer
Polish case law | Does not know Polish case law well | Polish statutes and case law, updated daily
Document work | Gives information, does not draft or check | Drafts on your templates and checks contracts
Into Word | Text copied into Word and formatted by hand | Drafts directly in the Word add-in
copy.security.lead: Gaius is hosted in the European Economic Area, your documents are never used to train models, and files on My drive are encrypted with keys held by users.
copy.preparation.title:
Recommended steps before
the trial starts
copy.preparation.lead: A few conversations that will get your team and the board ready for the trial.
copy.preparation.steps:
Talk to your DPO | To agree on the data processing rules and have the data processing agreement ready.
Talk to IT | To check accounts and sign-in, so the trial can start on day one without an IT project.
A short meeting with us | To pick the matters for the trial and decide who from the team takes part.
Talk to the board | So the board knows what you are testing and how you will judge the result for next year’s proposal.
copy.add-on-services.lead: Services that go beyond the areas above but follow from them.
copy.add-on-services.services:
Workshops | Workshops to set the group standard as a checklist Gaius reviews contracts against. | three workshops with the team
Development plans | Rolling Gaius out to lawyers in the group companies after the headquarters pilot. | after the trial
copy.contact-person.lead: Next step: start the 14-day trial with your team on real connection agreements, then use the results in your proposal to the board.
